name: tasheen-monorepo
description: Slipperze — enterprise-level e-commerce monorepo (backend + storefront + admin).

scripts.build: pnpm run type-check:api && turbo run build
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:api && pnpm run lint:tooling && turbo run lint
scripts.lint:api: eslint --no-eslintrc --config .eslintrc.backend.cjs --ext .ts apps/api modules packages/core/src packages/types/src packages/validation/src scripts
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/api/src/shared apps/api/src/plugins packages/core/src packages/types/src packages/validation/src scripts/testing scripts/review vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts tsconfig.tooling.json scratch/tsconfig.json apps/api/test/unit/database-test-safety.spec.ts apps/api/test/unit/operational-database-safety.spec.ts scratch/clear-database.ts scratch/create-test-db.ts scratch/drop-test-db.ts scratch/seed-admin.ts scratch/seed-development-db.ts scratch/inspect-wallets.ts scratch/verify-cart-inventory-check.ts apps/api/test/unit/restock-probes.spec.ts scratch/verify-restock-reminder.ts scratch/verify-restock-dispatcher.ts apps/api/test/unit/cart-expiry-probe.spec.ts scratch/test-expiry-renewal.ts apps/api/test/unit/cart-inventory-probe.spec.ts apps/api/test/unit/cart-expiry-inspection.spec.ts scratch/inspect-cart-expiry.ts apps/api/test/unit/reminder-inspection.spec.ts scratch/inspect-reminders.ts scratch/check-db-reminders.ts apps/api/test/unit/inventory-stock-inspection.spec.ts scratch/inspect-inventory-stock.ts apps/api/test/unit/admin-inspection.spec.ts scratch/verify-admin.ts apps/api/test/unit/wallet-inspection.spec.ts apps/api/test/unit/loyalty-inspection.spec.ts scratch/inspect-loyalty-data.ts apps/api/test/unit/database-catalog-inspection.spec.ts scratch/inspect-databases-local.ts scratch/list-databases.ts
scripts.type-check: pnpm run type-check:api && pnpm run type-check:tooling && turbo run type-check
scripts.lint:tooling: eslint --no-eslintrc --config .eslintrc.backend.cjs --ext .ts,.cjs "scripts/**/*.cjs" scratch packages/api-client packages/config vitest.config.ts vitest.setup.ts .eslintrc.backend.cjs .prettierrc.cjs --ignore-pattern "!.prettierrc.cjs"
